headline: Fed minutes showed nearly all officials expect another rate rise, and bitcoin hovered near $62,700 with fear at extreme lows, as Anthropic prepares to price its share sale tonight US time.

market.asOf: Read at about 19:55-20:05 UTC Wed 18 Nov (about 03:00 Thursday Bangkok). BTC $62,738 (down 1.51%) on CoinDesk's price page, stamped 2:59pm EST. ETH $1,768 (down 1.70% in 24 hours) on CoinGecko's ETH page, which gave no exact time (its table showed a different 24-hour figure). SOL $74.62 (up 1.33% in 24 hours) on Nexo's site ticker, also with no exact time. Prices move fast; use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: Extreme fear: alternative.me's Crypto Fear & Greed Index 11 (12 yesterday, 29 a week ago, 59 a month ago); CoinMarketCap's own Fear & Greed Index 12. Both read at about 19:55 UTC Wed 18 Nov.

stories.title: Fed minutes: nearly all officials expect another rate rise in December
stories.summary: Minutes of the Fed's October meeting, released at 2:00pm ET Wednesday, show almost all officials expect to raise interest rates again. Higher rates tend to pull money away from riskier assets like crypto, and bitcoin dipped right after the release.
points: The Fed released the minutes of its 27-28 October meeting at 2:00pm EST (19:00 UTC, 02:00 Thursday Bangkok), per the Federal Reserve.
Nearly all officials expect a quarter-point rate rise in December, and two floated a half-point move, per AP via Yahoo Finance.
The Fed held its key rate unchanged in October, with Lisa Cook and Beth Hammack dissenting in favour of a rise, per AP via Yahoo Finance.
Bitcoin fell about 0.6% and ether about 0.7% on Coinbase within 10 minutes of the release, per Phemex.
Markets price a rise on 9 December as near certain: about 95% on CME FedWatch per 24/7 Wall St, and 98% on LSEG futures per TipRanks.

sources.label: AP via Yahoo Finance: Fed minutes

stories.title: Bitcoin stuck near four-month lows as fear stays extreme and funds keep selling
stories.summary: Bitcoin is trading in the low $60,000s, well below its October high. Money is still leaving US bitcoin funds. One on-chain analyst calls this a 'value zone' but warns that does not mean the fall is over.
points: Bitcoin was about 26% below its October high of $87,200 on Wednesday morning, with about $377.4 million of leveraged positions liquidated, per CoinDesk.
It is below its 200-day ($72,900) and 365-day ($75,900) moving averages and hit a four-month low near $61,000 on 15 November, per CryptoQuant via The Block.

CryptoQuant says bitcoin has entered a 'value zone'; its head of research Julio Moreno said a −20% margin 'says Bitcoin is cheap relative to traders' cost basis, not that the decline is over,' per The Block.
US spot bitcoin ETFs had net outflows of $239.9 million on Tuesday 17 Nov, with BlackRock's IBIT losing $209.5 million, per Farside data reported by Coinpaper. Wednesday's figures were not out yet.

stories.title: Anthropic's share sale prices tonight amid reports of huge demand; Nvidia shares slip after results
stories.summary: AI company Anthropic is expected to set the price of its first public share sale after Wednesday's US close, with Nasdaq trading as ANT expected to start Thursday, per Yahoo Finance. Reports say demand could push the price well above its $70-78 range. Nvidia's revenue more than doubled, but its shares turned lower.
points: Anthropic is offering 825,000,000 shares at $70.00 to $78.00, listing on the Nasdaq Global Select Market as ANT, per Anthropic.
CNBC reports Anthropic is 'considering upsizing its IPO' and weighing a price 'well above USD 80/shr', per Newsquawk.
IBTimes reports orders of nearly $500 billion, with the final price expected after Wednesday's close.
Nvidia's revenue was $115.84 billion, more than double a year earlier, per Motley Fool; the shares 'dropped after opening higher', per Yahoo Finance, and were 2.12% lower at midday, per Motley Fool.

briefs.title: Binance wins $6.5B freezing order over October hack
briefs.summary: Abu Dhabi courts granted a worldwide freezing order covering 26,000 wallets; about $2.85B of roughly $6.34B affected has been frozen, per The Block.

briefs.title: Strategy stock and its preferred shares fall
briefs.summary: MSTR fell 4% to $91.32 and its STRC preferred hit its lowest since August at $95.75, per CoinDesk's live blog.

briefs.title: Bullish profit rises, $300M buyback
briefs.summary: Bullish's Q3 adjusted net income rose 35% to $18.7M and it authorized a $300M buyback, per The Block.

briefs.title: CoinShares sells its treasury ether
briefs.summary: CoinShares sold all its treasury ETH and half its SOL, raising $19.3M to fund possible share buybacks, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Variational raises $110M
briefs.summary: The on-chain derivatives platform raised $110M at a $1.5B valuation, led by Bain Capital Crypto, per The Block.

briefs.title: Visa Direct brings stablecoin prefunding to Asia-Pacific
briefs.summary: Visa Direct is extending stablecoin prefunding for cross-border payouts to Asia-Pacific, with a pilot alongside dtcpay, per The Block.

briefs.title: Backpack wins NFA approval for US derivatives
briefs.summary: Backpack now holds FCM, DCM and DCO licenses and plans to offer US users leveraged perpetual futures and event contracts, per The Block.

briefs.title: Six years in prison for crypto phishing scheme
briefs.summary: Tyler Robert Buchanan was sentenced to six years in US prison over a phishing scheme that stole at least $11.6M in crypto, per CoinDesk's live blog.

calendar.event: Fed minutes from the October meeting – released
calendar.note: Nearly all officials expect a quarter-point rise in December, per AP via Yahoo Finance. Fed's Kashkari speaks at 4:15pm ET (04:15 Bangkok), per Newsquawk.

calendar.event: Anthropic share sale priced, then first Nasdaq trading as ANT
calendar.note: Range $70-78 for 825M shares, per Anthropic. CNBC reports it may price well above $80, per Newsquawk. Price to be set Wednesday evening, first trade Thursday, per Yahoo Finance; no exact time given.

calendar.event: US jobless claims and Philly Fed survey
calendar.note: Claims forecast 196,000, prior 200,000; Philly Fed forecast 19.2, prior 20.9, per Finviz. Walmart reports at 7:00am ET, per Walmart via Finviz. Fed's Hammack speaks at 8:50am ET, per the Cleveland Fed.
Kristin N. Johnson and Steven Levine, nominated to the SEC, appear before the Senate Banking Committee with other nominees, per the committee's page.

KAITO and ZRO on Friday 20, ARIA and AKE on Saturday 21, MBG on Sunday 22, SOON on Monday 23, MON (the largest, about $252M) and SOSO on Tuesday 24, XPL and H on Wednesday 25 November. About 28,300 BTC, roughly $1.8B, of options expire at 08:00 UTC, per CryptoTicker. The bigger monthly expiry, about $5.7B, is Fri 27 Nov.

calendar.event: University of Michigan consumer sentiment (Nov, final)
calendar.note: Forecast 52, per Finviz; the preliminary November reading was 51.0, per Verified Investing. Fed's Waller speaks at 8:25am ET and Cook at 12:15pm ET (00:15 Sat Bangkok), per Finviz.
Prior 91.7, per FinanceCalendar. Workday and Dell report after the US close, per IfYouSpent.

calendar.event: US GDP (Q3 second estimate) and PCE inflation (Oct)
calendar.note: GDP prior 3.4% (the advance estimate), per the BEA; PCE prior 3.6% a year (core 3.1%), per IndexBox. Fed Beige Book at 2:00pm ET, per FinanceCalendar.

calendar.event: Thanksgiving: US stock market closed, then early close
calendar.note: NYSE closed Thursday and closes at 1:00pm ET Friday, per NYSE. A monthly bitcoin options expiry of about 88,000 BTC, or $5.7B, is Friday, per CryptoTicker.

calendar.event: Next Fed meeting and rate decision
calendar.note: Decision Wed 9 Dec. CME FedWatch showed about a 95% chance of a 0.25-point rise, per 24/7 Wall St; LSEG futures 98%, per TipRanks.
